description: A two-input amplifier with linear and exponential response and both a normal and an inverted output

params.text: Picks whether the control voltages act on the gain in a straight line or exponentially
Sets the gain with no voltage applied, marked 0 to 10
Attenuates the first control input before it reaches the gain

inputs.text: Controls the gain, scaled by the level knob above it
Controls the gain at full depth, with no attenuation of its own
A second audio input, summed with the first

outputs.text: The amplified signal with its sign flipped
